description: Rampanalgas Waterfall is a scenic waterfall located along the Madamas Road near the village of East Seco in Trinidad's Northern Range. It is accessible via a moderate hike making it a rewarding destination for hikers and nature lovers alike. Listed opening hours: 24 HOURS.
